newsitem.title: UK: Renishaw tumbles after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Renishaw tumbles after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Renishaw Plc Plc dived on Tuesday after the specialist engineering group issued a profit warning, dealers said.
Renishaw shares tumbled 62-1/2p to 280p by 1107 GMT.
In a trading statement, the group blamed sterling strength for the adverse effect on its results and warned pre-tax profits for the year to 30 June 1997 were likely to be below market expectations.

Renishaw said it expected pre-tax profits to be around 17.5 million stg -- including a 1.9 million profit on the sale of property -- but would have been 4.5 million stg higher if sterling had remained at the same level as last year.
The group's activities include the design, manufacture and sale of advanced precision metrology and inspection equipment as well as computer aided design and manufacturing systems.
